comments.content: The `cleanPoints` loop can crash or misbehave when many points are removed. `prevPos` is initialized to `points[0]`, but if `points[0]` itself gets spliced out (when the wrap-around iteration at `i == points.length` finds `points[0]` too close to the previous point and does `points.splice(0, 1)` then `break`), `prevPos` may reference a removed vertex during earlier iterations. More importantly, if the shape degenerates to fewer than 3 points after cleaning, `triangulateShape` will receive a degenerate contour. Consider guarding against reducing below 3 points and verifying `prevPos` tracking after the wrap-around splice.

The triangulation now uses `contractedContourVertices` / `expandedHoleVertices` which are only populated when `t == 0` inside the bevel loop. If `bevelEnabled` is false or `bevelSegments` causes the `t == 0` branch not to execute in the expected path, these arrays will be empty and `triangulateShape` will produce no faces. Please confirm the `t == 0` branch is always reached (i.e., the bevel loop always includes t=0) for both beveled and non-beveled geometry, otherwise faces will be missing.
